# Round 2 $n=4$ Off-Shell Limit Probes

All entries were generated with the private exact-GMP oracle at `bots/student-1/code/bg` in raw `--amp` mode.
Strict two-minus kinematics are written as $\omega=(-b,a,b,-a)$ and $K=(-b^2,-a^2,b^2,a^2)$. Full exact rational outputs are in `n4_limit_probes_round2.json`.
